newsitem.title: USA: Southern Investments UK to sell $480 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Southern Investments UK to sell $480 mln in debt.

text.p: Southern Investments U.K. Plc of Bristol, England is expected to sell $480 million in senior notes in a Yankee offering through Lehman Brothers, according to market sources.
The notes are likely to have five- and 10-year maturities and are expected to be rated Baa1/single-A, sources familiar with the deal said.
The offering may be priced as early as Friday; Merrill Lynch & Co Inc and J.P. Morgan & Co Inc will co-manage the offering, sources added.
Southern Investments owns 75 percent of South Western Electricity plc, a U.K. regional distribution company.
Syndicate officials at Lehman Brothers and Merrill Lynch declined to comment. J.P. Morgan did not return calls for comment.
